main.summary: Provides keyed asynchronous coordination for transfer operations.

method.name: AcquireItemLockAsync
method.summary: Acquire the lock associated with an item identifier.

method.name: AcquireItemLockLeaseAsync
method.summary: Acquire an item lock with the option to acquire a session lock on the same connection.
method.returns: Lease owning the item lock and connection.

method.name: TryAcquireItemLockAsync
method.summary: Attempts to acquire the item lock without waiting.
method.returns: An asynchronous lock releaser, or null when another operation holds the lock.

method.name: AcquireMutationScopeAsync
method.summary: Acquire the item and session locks required for a transfer mutation workflow.
method.remarks: The item and session locks use the same connection. The item lock is acquired first; the returned scope releases the session lock before the item lock.
method.returns: Scope owning the item and session locks.

method.name: AcquireSessionLockAsync
method.summary: Acquire the lock associated with a session identifier.
